messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — hotfix PR #19642 (reduce-gc-memory) is ready for final approval but CI queue is pretty long. Deploy blackout starts 2024-04-18 03:00 UTC. Need to decide merge timing.
maya: Link?
alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/19642 — small change, reclaims memory on large batches.
maya: thanks — I can rebase and run a local sanity if someone reruns CI after.
jordan: CI has a ~45m backlog on the integration lane right now. We could fast-track if we mark it hotfix and skip the nightly-only queue.
alex: @maya can you rebase? If so we'll aim to merge at ~02:00 UTC to beat the blackout.
maya: On it. running `git fetch && git rebase origin/main && git push --force-with-lease` — will post when done.
ci-bot: CI status: integration queued (position 12). Estimated start ~00:55 UTC.
sam: If integration flakes, prefer manual rerun by @jordan — I'll be on-call and can assist with rollout.
priya: Heads-up from release: if we merge after blackout starts we need emergency-merge approval from the release lead. Try to avoid.
maya: Rebase done, pushed. PR now shows green on unit tests.
ci-bot: CI status: integration started.
jordan: Watching the run. If the integration job flakes on the DB suite, I'll rerun the failing matrix shards instead of full rerun. @alex — want a canary after merge? we can roll to 10% for 30m.
alex: Yes — canary 10% for 30m. Merge window target 02:00 UTC if CI passes and no flakes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
